name: source-relative-color-saturation-fidelity
applicability: Apply the same source-relative color rules to photographs, illustrations, posters, product images, portraits, environments, and other supported image types.
coverage_profiles: images dominated by low saturation or near-neutral color
images mixing vivid local accents with restrained regions
flat graphics using discrete solid-color palettes
images where saturation is not a defining attribute

relative_relationships: separation between local saturation and global color cast
required_color_profile.measurement_boundary: Use source-relative language unless a trustworthy color-sampling tool is available; do not invent exact numeric color values.

required_compilation_behavior: Every platform prompt positively states the saturation level of each palette-defining region instead of relying on hue names alone.
A reported saturation drift changes only the affected color fields while already-correct structure and unrelated color regions remain locked.
Negative terms are included only when they directly conflict with observed source color or comparison evidence.
A constraint against a global color cast must not suppress correct local color, and local reinforcement must not alter restrained or neutral regions.
Flat graphics preserve solid-fill palette separation without gaining unsupported gradients, glow, texture, or photographic shading.

adapter_expectations.gpt: Attach source-relative saturation constraints to the affected objects or regions in complete relation-aware sentences.
adapter_expectations.grok: List color zones and their relative saturation hierarchy compactly when simplification would average them together.
adapter_expectations.midjourney: Place palette-defining chroma relationships after P0 geometry but before texture, using only source-supported negative constraints.

color_fidelity_gate: All platform-language variants preserve the same per-region hue, value, and saturation relationships.
A palette-defining saturation mismatch fails color fidelity even when the broad hue family is correct.
Global saturation is not raised or lowered indiscriminately.
The rule remains conditional on the current source instead of prescribing a preferred saturation style.
pass_criteria: The Canonical Visual Spec records hue, value, and saturation per applicable region plus relative relationships.
Reconstruction and adapter guidance distinguish local color from global cast without naming a fixed palette or scene.
GPT, Grok, and Midjourney apply the same facts through platform-appropriate syntax.
Final validation contains an explicit source-relative color fidelity gate.
No rule or regression contract depends on a transient or private image.
